front:
Enable DAI for a VLAN:
SW1(config)# [...]

Enable err-disable recovery for DAI rate limiting:
SW1(config)# [...]

Enable additional DAI validation checks:
SW1(config)# [...]
back: ip arp inspection validate (src-mac | dst-mac | ip)

front:
Configure a DAI trusted interface:
SW1(config-if)# [...]

back: ip arp inspection limit rate packets [burst interval seconds]

front:
Configure an ARP ACL entry mapping an IP address to a MAC address (permit)
SW1(config-arp-nacl)# [...]
back: permit ip host ip-address mac host mac-address

front:
Apply an ARP ACL to DAI:
SW1(config)# [...]
back: ip arp inspection filter arp-acl-name vlan vlan
